remarks: Check out this coveted end unit townhome in Grand Island's desirable Gun Creek subdivision with no rear neighbors! Welcome to 189 Sandstone Circle, a four bedroom, three and a half bath multi level property, only five years old! First level was designed with a spacious open floor plan that includes kitchen w/breakfast bar, handsome appliances, & soft close cabinetry; combination living room, dining room, morning room/flex space with luxury vinyl tile flooring, huge east facing windows overlooking wooded lot & access to balcony and backyard; 1st floor laundry/mud room and half bath; convenient access to two car attached garage and doublewide driveway; and best of all a beautiful first floor primary suite with east-facing windows again overlooking the wooded lot, luxury glamour bath, walk in closet, & tray ceiling. Second floor includes two additional bedrooms each with huge closets, the second full bathroom, large storage closet, and attic access. Finished basement with egress window includes fourth bedroom and third full bath in additional to ample storage space! HOA fee is only $185 per month & includes snow plowing and landscaping. Square footage verified by agent. Listed as both a Single MLS# B1689709 and a Condo/Townhome MLS B1689706.
